#: Plain TTT at a step batch of 256 sequences on 128 devices, against trunk_8k_10k.json's 128 on 64: at the same tokens (its step 5000 = the trunk's 10000, 10.5B tokens) and at the same steps (10000, twice the tokens). From scratch: a continuation of the same data at another step batch is refused. The schedule is the trunk's in tokens (warm-ups of 2500 steps, the same peak lr 1e-3, then flat). Evaluations every 1000 steps, eval_batches 1: the same 256 held-out sequences and masks per source as the trunk's 2 x 128, at the trunk's tokens up to step 5000 and at its steps 2000-10000. With one micro-batch per step the log has no noise scale (it needs grad_accum > 1).
#batch_size: a step batch of 256 sequences on 128 devices: 2 per device in one micro-batch, a dp 16 x fsdp 8 mesh
#warmup_steps: the trunk's 5000-step warm-ups at half the steps: the same 5.2B tokens
